prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 产品对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "型号" · longest unbreakable word 29px · one-line width 79px
  col 2: header "价格" · longest unbreakable word 50px · one-line width 50px
  col 3: header "屏幕" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 100px
  col 4: header "续航" · longest unbreakable word 20px · one-line width 59px
  col 5: header "重量" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 39px
  col 6: header "评价" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 445px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者比较四款手机的价格、主要规格和使用体验。","reading":"读者可先按型号定位，再纵向比较价格和规格，最后阅读评价中的使用场景与优缺点；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。","groups":["型号与价格共同帮助读者识别产品及其价位。","屏幕、续航和重量都是可逐列比较的规格，应保持紧凑且易于扫读。","评价是较长的描述性文字，需要更多宽度，并可借用行高自然换行。"],"keep_intact":["价格及货币符号","型号中的字母、数字和 Pro、Air、Max 等标识","屏幕尺寸、重量数值及其单位","续航数值及其单位"],"may_wrap":["评价可在自然语义边界换行，通常会决定行高。","屏幕的尺寸与显示技术可分行；较长型号也可在型号名称与后缀之间换行，并利用评价产生的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [100, 71, 110, 80, 60, 298] · table 720×252px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 36, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [100, 71, 90, 80, 60, 318] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [90, 71, 100, 80, 60, 318] · table 720×275px · row heights [36, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"型号、价格、续航和重量保持完整，规格列紧凑；屏幕中的尺寸与技术名称分行，评价也有足够空间，行内对应关系清楚。青柠 Air 一行较短，符合其内容较少的特点。","problems":"屏幕列中 LCD 恰好留在一行，而其他显示技术换到第二行，同类规格的排布不够一致；首条评价在“偏重”之间换行，略有停顿。","cause":"屏幕列宽 110px，内容区 89px，足以容纳较短的 LCD 表述，却不足以容纳 OLED 和 LTPO 表述；评价列宽 298px，使首条评价在该位置换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"型号和数值完整，屏幕尺寸与显示技术都分成两行，纵向比较较一致；评价列比 r1A 宽，长评的行文更舒展。","problems":"青柠 Air 的短评价本可放在单行，却被屏幕列的换行撑高，留下较多空白；第四条评价末尾的“制一般。”单独落在第二行，行长不均。","cause":"屏幕列宽 90px，内容区仅 69px，迫使 LCD 也换行；评价列宽 318px 时，第四条评价恰在“控制”之间换行。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"价格和主要数值保持完整，屏幕列呈统一的两行结构，评价列也较宽。","problems":"星河 X1 Pro 的 Pro 单独落到第二行，削弱了型号作为产品标识的整体性；青柠 Air 行同样因屏幕换行而出现较多空白。","cause":"型号列宽 90px，内容区 69px，容不下完整的星河 X1 Pro；屏幕列宽 100px，仍不足以让 LCD 表述保持单行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-review","widths":[100,71,105,80,60,303],"change":"以 r1A 为基础，将屏幕列缩窄 5px 并给评价列，保留完整型号和紧凑规格，观察稍宽的评价能否改善首条换行。"},{"name":"consistent-specs","widths":[100,71,90,80,60,318],"change":"以 r1B 的统一两行屏幕规格为基础保留完整型号，作为重视纵向比较的一种取舍；通过其他方案对照其额外行高是否值得。"},{"name":"more-review","widths":[100,71,90,75,60,323],"change":"从续航列再借 5px 给评价列，保持屏幕规格统一分行，尝试改善第四条评价在“控制”之间的换行，同时检查续航数值是否仍完整。"}]}
